title: MKTG100: Numeracy Skills
text:
I am a marketeer and like numbers


No textbook is needed. But if you want to buy a book, I recommend Daryanto (2020). This is a compilation book (I dont create it!) where chapters of this book are taken from Croft, Croft, and Davison (2006) and Berenson et al. (2012). I used this book in the past but realized that students were complaining the book was too thin to put under their pillows.




Berenson, Mark, David Levine, Kathryn A Szabat, and Timothy C Krehbiel. 2012. “Basic Business Statistics: Concepts and Applications.”


Croft, Anthony, Tony Croft, and Robert Davison. 2006. Foundation Maths. Pearson Education.


Daryanto, Ahmad. 2020. Basic Numeracy and Statistics (Complied by Ahmad Daryanto). Pearson.
